entities.summary: Natalie Chioma Achonwa is a Canadian former professional basketball player and coach, currently an assistant coach for the Seattle Storm of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA). She started coaching at the University of Michigan from 2024 through 2026. Achonwa is a four-time Olympian with the Canadian national team. She played for the Indiana Fever and Minnesota Lynx of the WNBA, and played college basketball for the Notre Dame Fighting Irish.
